tools.name: search_house_plans
tools.description: Use this when the user wants ready-made house plans, floor plan ideas or downloadable plans (for example "3 bedroom ranch under 2,000 sq ft", "small ADU", "barndominium"). Searches a library of about 500 free house plans by AI Architectures, each with a floor plan image, room sizes and free PDF, DXF

tools.name: get_house_plan
tools.description: Use this to show one house plan from search_house_plans in detail: description, every floor plan image and all free download links (PDF plan set, DXF per level, IFC, GLB).

tools.name: show_community_cad_drawings
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see what the AI drafter draws, or examples of AI-made CAD floor plans. Lists published drawings from the Plan Chat CAD studio (real, unretouched output), each with a preview, the brief it was drawn from, a free DXF download and a link to draw a similar one.

tools.name: prepare_cad_drawing_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a floor plan drawn as CAD (DXF/DWG) but is not signed in to an AI Architectures account here, or prefers to continue on the website, or wants to attach a sketch there. Returns a link that opens the Plan Chat CAD studio with the request already typed in; nothing is drawn

tools.name: get_design_tool_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants something AI Architectures does on its website from a photo or image: a remodel preview on a photo of their own home, a photoreal render from a sketch or model view, a render from a description, virtual staging, a listing photo kit, a clean floor plan image from a sketch

tools.name: start_cad_drawing
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to draw or design a floor plan as a real CAD drawing and wants it made now. The AI drafter of the Plan Chat CAD studio draws a layered, dimensioned plan (walls, doors, windows, furniture, dimensions, room names and areas) from the description and, if attached, a sketch or

tools.name: get_cad_drawing
tools.description: Use this to check a drawing started with start_cad_drawing (or one of list_my_cad_drawings): status, what the drafter says, room names, a preview image, the studio link and, when the account allows, DXF, DWG and PDF download links (valid for 10 minutes; call again for fresh ones). tools.name: change_cad_drawing
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to change one of their CAD drawings in words ("make the kitchen 4.2 m wide", "move the garage to the left", "add a window to bedroom 2"). The drafter makes the change as a new version (earlier versions stay in the studio). Spends credits from the user's AI Architectures a

tools.name: list_my_cad_drawings
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about their own drawings in the Plan Chat CAD studio. Lists them newest first with id, title, number of versions and whether one is being drawn now.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many AI Architectures credits their account has left before starting or changing a drawing.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the AI Architectures account behind this connection. The opaque id is the account id, unique and unchanged across token refresh, reconnection and changes to the email or name.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_my_cad_drawings, get_profile · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: prepare_cad_drawing_link, get_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_my_cad_drawings, get_profile · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: prepare_cad_drawing_link, get_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
